environment: Offline Node.js VM, selected post-Chromium-34 APIs removed, mocked Lampa, DOM and XMLHttpRequest; NOT an actual Crosswalk executable
tests: Plugin initializes without native Symbol, Map, Set, Promise, fetch and selected newer array/string/object APIs
Settings component, parameters and torrent/activity event listeners register
Movie scoring completes on seven Latin/Cyrillic titles, all scores finite
Patched result sort and filter complete and preserve expected result counts
TV season/episode scoring completes with Cyrillic titles and bracket episode ranges
